title: Chapter 236: Now I Have A Mentor
content:
Chapter 236: Now I Have A Mentor

Xiao Luo sincerely congratulated Qin Feng.

Hearing this, Qin Feng turned his head and immediately saw Lu Xue and Xiao Luo.

"Oh? It's you two."

"Haha, speaking of it, my achievements this time are thanks to this girl."

As he said that, Qin Feng suddenly looked at Lu Xue.

"I?"

Lu Xue was a little confused.

Qin Feng nodded, "If it weren't for your financial support, I would have returned in vain this time."

When everyone heard this, they immediately looked at Lu Xue.

Financial support?

If you play the list once, you will be a million immortal crystals.

Everyone was a little shocked. This woman was so grand.

If you say one million, please ask.

Although everyone here has the strength to take out millions of immortal crystals, it would be too difficult to ask others.

"What you said is nothing big. I just want to see what it looks like when you play the ranking."

Lu Xue said something indifferent.

Millions of immortal crystals, in her eyes, it's just a drizzle.

Upon hearing this, Qin Feng immediately understood what Lu Xue meant.

"Does the girl also want to make the rankings in the future?"

"Hahaha, then I wish the girl a title in the future."

To score a ranking?

Lu Xue smiled and said nothing.

She is not very interested in making the rankings yet.

At least, we must first improve our strength.

Now, looking at the entire inner courtyard of Tiandi Academy, there is nothing weaker than her.

At this time, Wang Hao, who had been silent on the side, suddenly said to Lu Xue: "Little girl, are you interested in learning swords with me?"

Just now, Wang Hao was secretly observing Lu Xue from the side.

He saw an extremely profound but vague sword intent in Lu Xue.

In addition, this girl helped Qin Feng, and she was reasonable and could accept the other party as her disciple.

But as soon as these words came out, everyone around them was suddenly in an uproar.

"What! Mentor Wang Hao wants to accept her as his apprentice?!"

"Damn it, I only spent one million immortal crystals to let mentor Wang Hao take him as his disciple. This is a genius!"

"The one who said she was stupid and had too much money just now stood up and got her to die!"

Everyone around them looked at Lu Xue with envious and jealous eyes.

Mentor Wang Hao is the tutor with the highest attainment of swordsmanship in the entire Tiandi Academy, and is also a well-known swordsmanship master in the entire fairyland. Even Duan Hen, who is the most popular now and is known as the Sword Emperor, has studied under Wang Hao's seat.

Therefore, even if you don’t have any talent for swordsmanship, as long as you learn from mentor Wang Hao, you can at least become a swordsmanship master in the Immortal Emperor realm in the future.

It is conceivable how much energy this old man has.

Beside Wang Hao, several Qin Feng's fellow disciples also looked at Lu Xue with curious eyes.

They did not see Lu Xue's swordsmanship talent.

Lu Xue didn't even take out the sword.

However, the teacher must have a reason for doing this.

And for some reason, they also like Lu Xue, and they would be happy to be their junior sister.

As for Qin Feng, after a brief moment of being stunned, Qin Feng also smiled.

This girl is obviously a rich woman.

Could it be that I will save all the money I have in the future to make a ranking and practice?

Just as Qin Feng was dreaming about spring and autumn, he was stunned the next moment.

"Sorry, I'm not interested."

Lu Xue directly rejected Wang Hao's invitation in front of everyone.

Everyone thought Lu Xue would agree without hesitation, and even cried and cried.

But now, Lu Xue actually refused.

Not only Qin Feng and everyone were stunned, but even Wang Hao himself was stunned for a moment.

"You don't want to?"

Wang Hao said a little uncertain.

This is the first time someone has rejected him.

However, facing Wang Hao's second inquiry, Lu Xue still shook her head.

"No."

"And, I already have a mentor."

As soon as these words came out, the audience was shocked again.

Only Xiao Luo next to Lu Xue was expressionless from beginning to end, as if he had known everything.

Haha, if he is asked to choose, he will refuse.

Just kidding, this old man is not as good as Sister Yin’s fragrance.

That is the real person of your own.

Originally, after Lu Xue rejected Wang Hao for the second time, everyone couldn't help but frown. The instructor had already asked you for the second time, but he still refused so ruthlessly. It's really, I don't want it anymore.

But after hearing that Lu Xue had a mentor, everyone suddenly realized it.

No wonder.

But who is this woman’s mentor?

Why have they never seen this woman?

Qin Feng frowned very tightly. He knew that the woman in front of him was definitely a newcomer to the inner courtyard.

Newcomers have mentors, they should be very clear about it.

Only Wang Hao suddenly realized it.

"Little girl, your mentor,"

"It's me."

Wang Hao just asked.

The next moment, a sudden sound suddenly sounded from the field.

Wang Hao was shocked all over and then slowly looked at the source of the sound.

Everyone was also shocked.

I saw a woman in ink-colored black suit slowly coming from a distance.

Her black hair was tied around her head, her eyes were extremely clear. From the outside, she looked like a young woman.

But when Wang Hao saw this woman, he shook his head and smiled bitterly.

"It's you."

The person coming was Xiao Yin.

"Sister Yin!"

Seeing Xiao Yin, Xiao Luo hurriedly ran to Xiao Yin with great sincerity.

Lu Xue hesitated for a moment, then came to Xiao Yin.

Xiao Yin smiled slightly and smiled lightly at Wang Hao in the distance, saying, "Mr. Wang, sorry, Lu Xue has arrived at my door."

Hearing this, Wang Hao looked at Lu Xue, then looked at Xiao Luo, and then smiled and said, "That's a pity."

But in his heart, Wang Hao's view of Lu Xue has greatly improved.

With Xiao Yin's eyes, he was able to accept this girl. It seems that he was indeed not wrong.

This little girl is indeed outstanding.

"Teacher, who is this?"

At this time, Qin Feng asked in a low voice to Wang Hao.

Not only Qin Feng, but everyone who was doing it looked puzzled by the woman who suddenly appeared in front of him.

He looks so young, he is probably one round older than them at most.

Can you be a tutor?

When did there be such a young tutor in the college?

Upon hearing this, Wang Hao chuckled.

"I think you are not unfamiliar with her. Her name is Xiao Yin. She is not only the tutor of the inner courtyard, but also your senior sister."

Wang Hao's voice kept echoing from the field.

Everyone looked at the young woman in front of them in amazement.

The next moment, the scene was completely sensational.

"Let's go! This is Xiao Yin!!"

"Xiao Yin?! That Xiao Yin who dominated the list of evil spirits?!"

"She, she is still alive, I know how could such a person die so easily."

After Xiao Yin left the academy, he completely lost the news.

Not only the world, but even the people in the academy thought that Xiao Yin had fallen outside.
